faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Dell Latitude E5270, E5470, E5570 and Precision 3510/M3510 (62Wh, 4-cell version). Note these models also come with 47Wh and 84Wh battery options that look similar but aren't interchangeable — the part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.
